title: Newtonian Gravitation
description: The classical theory of gravitational attraction in which point masses exert an attractive inverse-square force on each other, with forces superposed for distributions of matter. It is distinct from the relativistic account of gravity as spacetime geometry.

relations.note: The isolated Newtonian two-body interaction produces Keplerian relative orbits.
A fixed point source is an important attractive inverse-square central force.
